title: LLM-VulnGen: A Benchmark Dataset of LLM-Generated Web Vulnerabilities
description: A benchmark dataset of 1,080 web application code samples generated by four LLMs (Gemma3-27b, DeepSeek-7b, Mistral-7b, Phi4-14b) across Python (Flask), Node.js (Express), and PHP, labelled with detected security vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, command injection, path traversal, SSRF, insecure deserialization). Created to study and benchmark the security of LLM-generated web code.
